thread:
Nina R: Thanks for the update — opening a quick follow-up thread for partnership / GTM Qs after today's all-hands.
Tom H: Quick: are we doing deal registration for the pilot partners or just referral credits? Need to know so AEs don't double-touch.
Priya V: For the pilot we'll accept deal registration but with simple criteria: registration expires in 90 days, partner must own intro, and AE must not be in active pursue stage. Details in the partner guide draft.
Luis G: What's the ACV threshold to classify as partner-sourced vs partner-assisted? This affects comp credit.
Elena B: Proposal on comp: partner-sourced = 100% partner-sourced lead and partner registered = 50% credit to partner-influenced quota; partner-assisted = 25% credit. Rev comp to confirm next week.
Tom H: And onboarding / enablement timeline? We promised enablement sessions before go-live.
Priya V: Two-week enablement: week 1 sales enablement + deal lab, week 2 technical onboarding (connector + sandbox). We'll book slots with each partner.
Nina R: Can marketing confirm co-marketing spend during pilot? We said we'd fund events and a GTM blitz.
Elena B: Marketing earmarked $25k total for pilot co-marketing (webinars, paid social, joint PR). Use request form: https://redwood.app/marketing/co-marketing-request (internal).
Luis G: Integration checkpoints: do we require a certified connector for private deployments or is a simple connector enough for pilot?
Priya V: Pilot accepts "verified connector" defined as: SSO support + data minimization doc + automated health checks. Certification path documented in Confluence.
Tom H: Reporting: what metrics do partners expect? MRR, demos scheduled, pipeline created? Need a dashboard.
Nina R: Suggested KPIs: introductions, qualified opps, pipeline $ value, demo-to-opp conversion, time-to-first-deal. RevOps to build a partner dashboard in Looker.
ops-bot: Reminder: partnership intake form submission required for pilot consideration. Link: https://redwood.app/forms/partner-intake (internal).
Elena B: Final ask to leadership: can we provide a one-pager for AEs explaining partner economics and how to credit partners? That will reduce confusion.
Nina R: I'll draft the AE-facing one-pager and share it in #sales-ops by Wednesday.
Priya V: I'll sync with RevOps to wire the reporting and with engineering on connector checklist.
Tom H: Thanks — this helps. If legal needs to see registrations, ping me.
Elena B: We'll compile owners and send a recap by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
